title: Three directions. One independent developer.
summary: Compare three completely different ways to position Matt Sidnell for freelance web development, agency overflow and contract opportunities. Each concept is responsive and has working navigation and contact links.
notice: Design review only. All concepts are non-production prototypes. Project descriptions are based on existing work; illustrative mockups are not project screenshots. No contact form submissions are collected.

concepts.name: The Independent
concepts.description: Warm, editorial and reassuring. Makes the developer approachable while giving agencies confidence in delivery and communication.

concepts.name: The Studio
concepts.description: A confident creative portfolio with huge type, punchy colours and a fast project-led journey. Designed to stand out to digital agencies.

concepts.name: The Systems Mind
concepts.description: Dark engineering aesthetic, interactive project filters and architecture-focused positioning for specialist build contracts.
